## Validation
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` green
- [ ] `npm run e2e` (if a screen or flow changed)
- [ ] `npm run test:ps1` (if `service/` or `scripts/*.ps1` changed)
- [ ] `npm run skills:check` (if the CLI or `skills/` changed; `references/cli.md` updated in both variants)
- [ ] Sensitive change (auth, guards, scheduler, claim, directory, migration) came with the test that fails without it
